h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bidhannagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bidhannagar

c: Bidhannagar, better known as Salt Lake, is a planned township on the eastern edge of Kolkata, laid out in blocks with a park in almost every one. Its Sector V is one of the main IT and office areas of the city. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bidhannagar to block committees, housing cooperatives, schools, office campuses and the municipal corporation's parks.

Block parks in Salt Lake are compact and closely watched by residents, so the gym has to fit in without taking over the lawn or the walking path. Office campuses in Sector V have a different need: a corner where staff can exercise during a break. In both cases we start from your site plan and mark each machine with its clear space. The machines are made at our Vasai factory, about 1,650 km away, and come by road with installation by our team or a local dealer.

items.q: Can a Salt Lake block committee order a few machines for its park?
items.a: Yes. Many block parks start with three or four machines. Send us a sketch of the park with its paths and trees, and we will suggest where the machines should go.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment go on a paved office terrace?
items.a: Some machines can be self-standing on a firm paved surface. We check the surface and load before confirming. Send us photos and the size of the terrace.

items.q: How do the machines cope with Kolkata's monsoon?
items.a: Frames are galvanised and seats are roto-moulded plastic, so rain does not rust or rot them. Keep drains around the gym clear and wipe the seats before use after rain.
